name: lacuna-desk
description: Connects you to Nic's live Lacuna services: the news desk, which follows companies across news outlets and their own filings, and the notification hub, which holds every alert the monitors have sent. Both need a personal access key from Nic. Install the lacuna plugin alongside this one for the skills that read them.

news_token.title: News desk key
news_token.description: The news desk key Nic sent you. Leave blank if he did not send one.

hub_token.title: Alerts key
hub_token.description: The alerts key Nic sent you. Leave blank if he did not send one.
